question: A worker’s average income for a week is ₹180. He earned ₹115, ₹212, ₹170, ₹165, ₹185, and ₹225 from Monday to Saturday. Find his Sunday’s income.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net deviation from the average (180) must be zero.

Monday to Saturday deviations: (−65) + (+32) + (−10) + (−15) + (+5) + (+45) = −8

To balance this −8 deviation, Sunday’s income must be 8 more than the average.

Sunday’s income = 180 + 8 = ₹188.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹188.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Average income for 7 days = ₹180; Incomes of 6 days = ₹115, ₹212, ₹170, ₹165, ₹185, ₹225.

**Formula Used:** Total Sum = Average × Number of terms; Missing Value = Total Sum − Sum of given values.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70ffce0b70b24013c7c38ac52074fe348f7fca4cb8d3c11b161119a3d2536374.png] 

⇒ Total income for the week = 180 × 7 = ₹1260

⇒ Sum of income (Mon to Sat) = 115 + 212 + 170 + 165 + 185 + 225

⇒ Sum (Mon to Sat) = ₹1072

⇒ Sunday’s income = Total week income − Sum (Mon to Sat)

⇒ Sunday’s income = 1260 − 1072 = ₹188

**∴ The correct answer is ₹188.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Mean Property

The sum of the deviations of a set of values from their arithmetic mean is always zero. ∑(xᵢ − x̄) = 0.

Weighted Average

When two groups with averages A₁ and A₂ and sizes n₁ and n₂ are combined, the new average is (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Inclusion/Exclusion Rule

If one value is added to a group, New Value = New Average + (Change in Average × Old Number of items).
